### Findings
This analysis summarizes completed items at the category grain for authorized products (product IDs 2 and 3, enforced via executor-bound views). Aggregations are calculated at the item grain (`order_items` joined to `products`), filtered by `status = 'Complete'`, with no date filter applied [q1]. Complete revenue is defined as `SUM(sale_price)` and completed volume as item count `COUNT(*)`.

| category | complete_revenue | complete_items |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Footwear | 210.0 | 7 |
| Outerwear | 140.0 | 7 |

Across all recorded history within the authorized scope, Footwear produced 210.0 in complete revenue across 7 items, while Outerwear produced 140.0 in complete revenue across 7 items [q1].

### Limitations
- The query did not apply a date filter or date grouping, so date range and historical trend coverage were not measured [q1].
- Distinct order and customer counts were not queried, so the distribution of items across individual orders or customers remains unmeasured [q1].

### Action items (proposed)
- What is the monthly breakdown of complete revenue and completed item counts by category across authorized products?
- How many distinct orders (`COUNT(DISTINCT order_key)`) and distinct customers (`COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key)`) generated the completed items in each category?
